A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the corrosion degradation of the YSZ and LnMA coatings was mainly controlled by the microstructural features of the coatings and the chemical reactions between the molten salts and the coatings, respectively.
a much better resistance of the APS LnMA thermal barrier coatings to the molten salt corrosion than the YSZ coating could be achieved by a proper selection of the Ln element.

the APS LnMA coating is a promising alternative to the YSZ coating for molten salt applications.
